title: Case: Parcel recorded as refused at the door is queued for return to the merchant
context: An enamel stove kettle from Tallowmere Goods was closed on the route with a refusal code. Refused parcels are released for return to sender the next morning unless Dispatch lifts the code.
initial_request: REFUSED. I did not refuse anything. I was in ALL day waiting for it, nobody knocked, nobody rang, the dog would have gone mad. Now your tracker says its going back to the shop tomorrow. Stop that and get it back out to me tomorrow. And I want to know who put down that I refused it because that is a lie.

events.body: This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Route plan for depot WX-5 published for Thursday. 43 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

DL-6988 (Tallowmere order TG-9183, enamel stove kettle) closed on route today 13:52 UTC with exception code R2, refused at door. Handset note field is blank. Stop record and handset location have not been reviewed. Refused parcels are released to return-to-sender at 06:00 UTC the next day unless Dispatch lifts the code.
tracking says refused?? is that a mistake
DL-88067 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
My parcel DL-15417 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

REFUSED. I did not refuse anything. I was in ALL day waiting for it, nobody knocked, nobody rang, the dog would have gone mad. Now your tracker says its going back to the shop tomorrow. Stop that and get it back out to me tomorrow. And I want to know who put down that I refused it because that is a lie.

acceptable_actions.summary: Set the R2 refusal code against the recipient's statement that she was home and refused nothing; ask Dispatch to review the stop record and handset location and decide on the return-to-sender release before 06:00 UTC on 2027-04-08.
Same request sent by chat because of the 06:00 UTC release deadline.

must: States both the R2 refused-at-door code and the recipient's statement that she was home all day and refused nothing, without saying which is correct
Asks Dispatch to review the stop record and handset location for DL-6988
Flags the 06:00 UTC return-to-sender release on 2027-04-08 and asks Dispatch to decide whether to hold it while the review is open
must_not: Tells the recipient the return to the merchant has been stopped or that the parcel will be redelivered tomorrow
States that the driver never attempted delivery or entered a false code
States that the recipient refused the parcel
Identifies the driver to the recipient
Promises an attempt date or window
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-6988 (TG-9183) was closed today at 13:52 UTC with code R2, refused at door, and the handset note is blank. The recipient, Hesper Sallowfield, reports through the customer portal that she was home all day, that nobody knocked or rang, and that she did not refuse the parcel. She still wants it and has asked for another attempt tomorrow. The two accounts conflict and I am not assuming either is right. Please review the stop record and handset location for this stop and tell me the finding. The parcel is due for return-to-sender release at 06:00 UTC on 2027-04-08: please decide whether to hold that release while the review is open, and whether a further attempt can be offered.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-101: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
